verdicts.title: The relational complexity of linear groups acting on subspaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The relational complexity of a subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{Sym}(Ω)$ is a measure of the way in which the orbits of $G$ on $Ω^k$ for various $k$ determine the original action of $G$. Very few precise values of relational complexity are known.
